extras: Operates entirely offline with zero network access and telemetry. Includes a write-back safety net to prevent note corruption.
intentEvidence: Convert messy AI-generated LaTeX into something Obsidian's MathJax actually renders
problem: AI-generated LaTeX often uses non-standard delimiters or bare formulas that Obsidian's MathJax cannot render correctly.
summary: A converter that transforms non-standard LaTeX delimiters and bare formulas into Obsidian-compatible MathJax syntax while preserving surrounding Markdown structure.
